title: Log smoothness with invertible chart torsion preserves log regularity
statement: Let $f:(X,M_X)\to(Y,M_Y)$ be a morphism of locally Noetherian fine saturated log schemes in the sense of [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Suppose $(Y,M_Y)$ is log regular in the stratum and dimension sense of that definition. Assume that etale locally on source and target there are compatible fs charts $A\to M_Y$, $B\to M_X$ and a homomorphism $h:A\to B$ for which $h^{\rm gp}$ is injective, the torsion subgroup of its cokernel is finite of order invertible on the source, and the induced scheme morphism $X\to Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[A]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[B]$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Here $\mathbf Z[C]$ denotes the monoid ring, free as an abelian group on symbols $z^c$ with $z^cz^{c\prime}=z^{c+c\prime}$. This is the chart meaning of log smooth in this statement. Then $(X,M_X)$ is log regular in the same sense. In particular the cokernel in the chart condition is allowed to have nonzero torsion of invertible order; it need not be torsion-free.

source.place: Expose VI, 1.8, printed p.70 (log smooth over log regular implies log regular); chart interpretation as in Expose XVI, Proposition 3.6.3, printed p.252.
